item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We believe this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. The only proportionate response is a legally binding prohibition on its development.

2. If humanity builds superintelligent AI in the next 20 years, at least a billion people will die. We refuse to treat that outcome as an acceptable risk. We need a legally binding prohibition on developing superintelligence.

3. Superintelligent AI will not be just another technology. If it is built within 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must prohibit its development before companies or governments create it.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 109 words

We need to say this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. This is not a distant or abstract concern. It is a foreseeable consequence of creating systems more capable than humanity and beyond meaningful human control. No company, government, or laboratory has shown that such systems can be built safely, and no competitive advantage can justify gambling with lives on this scale. We are working for the only response proportionate to the danger: a legally binding prohibition on developing superintelligence, enforced before the race to build it becomes an irreversible global disaster.
